baseline.description: Remove new engine patch from build and restore predecessor numeric-domain and public index; rebuild exact predecessor engine bytes; run final identical tests. Restore changes and rebuild afterward. API/unsupported-operation baseline, not51 corrected engine bugs. Combined timeouts remain failures with undiagnosed cause; isolated runs do not erase them.

conformance.note: Concrete modulus and strict-equality variants, not symbolic completeness or numeric constraint solving.

interning.key: Exact operator, ordered Number identities and signed constant strings
interning.predicates: Separate SameValue and strict-equality caches; symmetric operands; strict equality normalizes signed-zero constant keys; NaN constant folds after provenance validation
interning.abstractSelfEquality: Remains a predicate because NaN is possible

scriptForks.owner: Selected guest properties, global bindings and execution contexts; not a verified transitive owner

react.scope: Fresh source-engine and native runs compare snapshots, state and layout/cleanup events. Test-only predicate DTO specialization supplies concrete Boolean results; Number state retains terms.

retainedFindings: Initial identity matcher inspected an opaque Boolean while printing inequality; use a native Boolean identity comparison instead.
Initial budget test attempted further evaluation after a host error; Agent retained that error. Direct domain budget calls now avoid pretending the poisoned Agent is usable.
Initial negative-zero React assertion required a remainder predicate even when an eager bailout prevented rendering. Final assertion verifies the bailout and absence of opaque parity.
Initial132 focused cases preceded exact term interning, recomputed parity, and two-input matrix coverage. Final153 focused/2244 units pass.
Combined final-source predecessor run has six unchanged five-second React timeouts. Separate final-source runs record51 failures and eight controls; do not relabel the combined run.
Initial root check rejected Markdown table formatting; formatted only the affected document and reran successfully.
limitations: No general numeric feasibility solver. Derived predicates are not independent external inputs; Boolean assignments can be infeasible.
Low-level host-Boolean comparison helpers stay unchanged. Loose equality, ordering, multiplication, division, numeric truthiness and string conversion remain unsupported for opaque Numbers.
Budgets do not bound parsing, all concrete/native work, allocation, collection or serialization. Expanding shared DAGs can grow exponentially.
Original host-effect guard unchanged. No sound React branch isolation, guarded transitions, repeated-state families, automatic React report producer or integrated demo.
React fixture holds one step prop per run. It does not implement interactive step changes or the full lazy/Suspense demo.
Fresh executions are independent oracles, not shared-prefix React exploration.
